prompt: Segment the chronic stroke lesion in the T1-weighted image of sub-M2191 (ds004884/ARC, OpenNeuro), producing a binary lesion mask in native T1w space.
reference: Expert manual lesion tracing (ARC), rigid-registered from native T2w into T1w space.
threshold_basis: FIXED (literature): full=0.70 at manual-tracing inter-rater ceiling on T1w (Dice 0.727; Tavenner et al. 2023, Front Neuroimaging 1:1098604, doi:10.3389/fnimg.2022.1098604). pass=0.50 near automated SOTA on ATLAS v2.0 (Dice ~0.50-0.58; Deb et al. 2023, BeSt-LeS, arXiv:2310.07060). Population: chronic-stroke T1w manual tracing (ATLAS v2.0; Liew et al. 2022, Sci Data 9:320, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01401-7). Single subject -> no LOTO envelope.
references: Tavenner BP, Donnelly MR, Barisano G, Liew S-L. Front Neuroimaging 1:1098604, 2023. doi:10.3389/fnimg.2022.1098604 (inter-rater manual-tracing Dice 0.727, T1w).
Liew S-L, Tavenner BP, Donnelly MR, et al. ATLAS v2.0. Sci Data 9:320, 2022. doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01401-7 (chronic-stroke T1w manual-lesion dataset).
Deb P, Baru LB, Dadi K, S BR. BeSt-LeS. MICCAI BrainLes 2023, arXiv:2310.07060 (automated SOTA on ATLAS v2.0, Dice ~0.50-0.58).
